install:
set -eux
cd /workspace/server
make setup-python
make prepare INPUT_DIR=tests/fixtures/proves
cd /workspace/client
make setup
test -f /workspace/server/runtime/config/etc/yamcs.yaml
test -d /workspace/server/.venv
test -d /workspace/client/.venv
start:
set -eux
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
  if [ ! -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg ]; then
    curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
  fi
  echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo \"$VERSION_CODENAME\") stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list >/dev/null
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin fuse-overlayfs iptables
fi
sudo update-alternatives --set iptables /usr/sbin/iptables-legacy || true
sudo update-alternatives --set ip6tables /usr/sbin/ip6tables-legacy || true
sudo mkdir -p /etc/docker
printf '%s\n' '{' '  "storage-driver": "fuse-overlayfs",' '  "features": { "containerd-snapshotter": false }' '}' | sudo tee /etc/docker/daemon.json >/dev/null
if ! sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo dockerd >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
  sudo docker info >/dev/null
fi
sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock || true
cd /workspace/server
if ! docker image inspect proves-yamcs:5.12.8 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  make docker-image
fi
docker compose up -d yamcs
.venv/bin/python -c "from proves_yamcs.supervisor import wait_until_ready; wait_until_ready('http://127.0.0.1:8090', 'fprime-project', 180)"
